CHIEF COMPLAINT: Abdominal pain for 3 days.

HISTORY OF PRESENT ILLNESS: 33-year-old with right lower quadrant abdominal pain, worsening, associated with low-grade fever and decreased appetite.

PAST MEDICAL HISTORY: No chronic conditions.

PHYSICAL EXAM: Abdomen soft, mild diffuse tenderness, no rebound or guarding noted.

ASSESSMENT: Appendicitis, likely, recommend surgical evaluation.

PLAN: Refer to surgery for urgent evaluation, NPO, IV fluids pending transfer.
